    "id":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":256,"pattern":"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]*$"},
    "digest":{"type":"string","pattern":"^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"},
    "time":{"type":"string","format":"date-time","pattern":"^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\\.[0-9]+)?Z$"},
    "producerIdentity":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"required":["producerId","bootId","producerType"],"properties":{"producerId":{"$ref":"#/$defs/id"},"bootId":{"$ref":"#/$defs/id"},"producerType":{"$ref":"#/$defs/id"}}},
    "correlation":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"required":["pipelineRunId","moduleId","gateId","attemptId","claimId","claimGeneration","traceId","parentEventId"],"properties":{"pipelineRunId":{"$ref":"#/$defs/id"},"moduleId":{"anyOf":[{"$ref":"#/$defs/id"},{"type":"null"}]},"gateId":{"anyOf":[{"$ref":"#/$defs/id"},{"type":"null"}]},"attemptId":{"anyOf":[{"$ref":"#/$defs/id"},{"type":"null"}]},"claimId":{"anyOf":[{"$ref":"#/$defs/id"},{"type":"null"}]},"claimGeneration":{"anyOf":[{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":9007199254740991},{"type":"null"}]},"traceId":{"anyOf":[{"$ref":"#/$defs/id"},{"type":"null"}]},"parentEventId":{"anyOf":[{"$ref":"#/$defs/id"},{"type":"null"}]}}},
    "producerRecord":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"required":["schemaVersion","recordId","producer","sequence","recordType","occurredAt","correlation","payload","recordDigest"],"properties":{"schemaVersion":{"const":"producer-record.v1"},"recordId":{"$ref":"#/$defs/id"},"producer":{"$ref":"#/$defs/producerIdentity"},"sequence":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":9007199254740991},"recordType":{"$ref":"#/$defs/id"},"occurredAt":{"$ref":"#/$defs/time"},"correlation":{"$ref":"#/$defs/correlation"},"payload":{},"recordDigest":{"$ref":"#/$defs/digest"}}},

    "gapReport":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"required":["schemaVersion","producer","pipelineRunId","fromSequence","toSequence","state","reportedAt","reasonCode"],"properties":{"schemaVersion":{"const":"producer-gap-report.v1"},"producer":{"$ref":"#/$defs/producerIdentity"},"pipelineRunId":{"$ref":"#/$defs/id"},"fromSequence":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":9007199254740991},"toSequence":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":9007199254740991},"state":{"enum":["missing","unavailable","restored"]},"reportedAt":{"$ref":"#/$defs/time"},"reasonCode":{"$ref":"#/$defs/id"}}},
    "producerClosure":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"required":["schemaVersion","closureId","producer","pipelineRunId","firstSequence","finalSequence","recordCount","requiredEvidenceIds","closedAt","closureDigest"],"properties":{"schemaVersion":{"const":"producer-closure.v1"},"closureId":{"$ref":"#/$defs/id"},"producer":{"$ref":"#/$defs/producerIdentity"},"pipelineRunId":{"$ref":"#/$defs/id"},"firstSequence":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":9007199254740991},"finalSequence":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":9007199254740991},"recordCount":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":9007199254740991},"requiredEvidenceIds":{"type":"array","maxItems":10000,"uniqueItems":true,"items":{"$ref":"#/$defs/id"}},"closedAt":{"$ref":"#/$defs/time"},"closureDigest":{"$ref":"#/$defs/digest"}}},

function encodeString(value:string):string { for(let index=0;index<value.length;index+=1){const unit=value.charCodeAt(index);if(unit>=0xd800&&unit<=0xdbff){const next=value.charCodeAt(index+1);if(!(next>=0xdc00&&next<=0xdfff))throw new TypeError('RFC8785_INVALID_UNICODE');index+=1;}else if(unit>=0xdc00&&unit<=0xdfff)throw new TypeError('RFC8785_INVALID_UNICODE');}return JSON.stringify(value); }
export function canonicalJson(value:unknown):string { if(value===null)return 'null';if(typeof value==='boolean')return value?'true':'false';if(typeof value==='string')return encodeString(value);if(typeof value==='number'){if(!Number.isFinite(value))throw new TypeError('RFC8785_INVALID_NUMBER');return JSON.stringify(value);}if(Array.isArray(value)){const values:string[]=[];for(let index=0;index<value.length;index+=1){if(!Object.hasOwn(value,index))throw new TypeError('RFC8785_INVALID_ARRAY');values.push(canonicalJson(value[index]));}return `[${values.join(',')}]`;}if(typeof value==='object'){const prototype=Object.getPrototypeOf(value);if(prototype!==Object.prototype&&prototype!==null)throw new TypeError('RFC8785_INVALID_OBJECT');const record=value as Record<string,unknown>;return `{${Object.entries(record).sort(([left],[right])=>left<right?-1:left>right?1:0).map(([key,child])=>`${encodeString(key)}:${canonicalJson(child)}`).join(',')}}`;}throw new TypeError('RFC8785_INVALID_TYPE'); }
